answer: The harbor schedule is applied in signal and vault exposes each instalment. An hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and hence 33% arrives at settlement and the rest over 7 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3566 identities would post 3190 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
